intents_zh: 寫 NetworkPolicy 限制 pod 流量
幫我做 networkpolicy 只放 namespace 內
code:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: {{policy_name}}
  namespace: {{namespace}}
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      {{target_label_key}}: {{target_label_value}}
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: {{allowed_namespace}}
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: {{allowed_port}}
summary_zh: NetworkPolicy 只放行指定 namespace 來源、指定 port 的入站流量
